item.title: Super Star Torn To Pieces By Black Hole Releases Energy Equal To 400 Billion Suns

Affectionately called the "Whippet" (officially AT2024wpp), this Tidal Disruption Event (TDE) occurred on a scale that defied traditional expectations.
